title: West Peek forms register
rule: Sequoia, 22 Sep 2026: 'make all forms automatically default to adding names to our master network sheet.' Every transmitting form on a West Peek property adds the person to the contacts tab of the master network sheet by default. A form that goes anywhere else is recorded here, at the time of the ask, with a reason, a namer and a date - never a note in a chat log.

destination_values.sheet: Reaches the contacts tab of the master network sheet.
destination_values.intake_queue: Reaches the master network sheet, but the intake_queue tab for human review rather than contacts.
destination_values.own_store: Writes this property's own datastore by design; an explicit human-gated bridge to the network exists.
destination_values.excluded_not_ours: PERMANENT, PRINCIPLED EXCLUSION. The people filling this form in are not West Peek's contacts - they belong to a client. This is SETTLED, not pending. No sweep, agent or future pass may treat it as an unwired gap to close. Requires reason, named_by, date.
destination_values.pending_decision: Genuinely undecided and still open. Requires reason, named_by, date. This is the ONLY category that means 'not done yet'.
destination_values.no_form: Repo checked, ships no transmitting form.
destination_values.named_stop: Should reach the sheet but cannot be wired from here. Requires the exact reason.

enforced_by: scripts/validate_forms.mjs rule FORM-10. Rows whose repo is join-west-peek-main and whose destination is 'sheet' are checked against the actual markup in sites/ and dist/ and against the wiring in functions/api/lead.js. Rows for other repos are inventory: FORM-10 asserts they are complete and reasoned, not that this repo can see them.

They are internal working state, not network contacts, and the deliberate bridge to the network already exists: an operator clicks 'propose to network', which posts the person to Network OS /api/intake/create for review. Making every keystroke of internal firm ops a network contact would be the wrong default, not a missing one.

scope_rule: A form belongs in the master network sheet only when the people filling it in are WEST PEEK'S OWN contacts. A client-service property's submissions belong to the client, not to West Peek; routing them into West Peek's network sheet would take client data into a West Peek asset. Such a property is 'excluded_not_ours' - a permanent, principled exclusion, never an open item. Owner's rule, 22 Sep 2026.
